---
title: smalldocs 0.5.1
subtitle: Simpler Markdown copies for agents
date: 2026-10-21
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

The Markdown copy of each page, `page.llms.md`, is now made from the page's own Markdown, not from its
HTML. A callout or a tabset is an HTML `<div>`, and links go to the other pages' copies. A notebook's
copy is made as Jupyter's nbconvert makes it, with its pictures saved as files. [Pages for
agents](../guide/llms.qmd) says what a copy holds.

The API pages write a function given as a default by its name, such as `ask_tty`. They wrote its memory
address before, which changed at each build.
